shortBio.en: Kings of Leon frontman; gravel vocal from Youth & Young Manhood onward.
shortBio.zh: Kings of Leon 主唱；自《Youth & Young Manhood》起的沙哑人声。

body.en: Born 1982, Tennessee. Lead vocals and rhythm guitar for Kings of Leon. Writes with brothers Nathan, Jared, and cousin Matthew.
body.zh: 1982 年生于田纳西。Kings of Leon 主唱与节奏吉他。与兄弟 Nathan、Jared 及表弟 Matthew 共同写歌。
